Overall, this digital food scale with touch buttons combines sleek aesthetics with practical functionality, making it a must-have for any home chef or culinary enthusiast looking to elevate their cooking game.This is a great small kitchen scale for your cooking or baking needs! It's lightweight and compact to store in any drawer and seems to be very accurate. It supports several different measurement scales and switches at the touch of a button. One thing to note - the tare/zero function takes a second to zero out. It took me pressing the button a few times to realize you need to press and wait a second for it to show 0. Otherwise this is a fantastic home scale!This digital scale is very lightweight, compact, and easy to store. It comes with the battery, and it is very easy to open the battery compartment and install the battery. Clear and detailed instructions are included. It is simple to switch between grams/kilograms/teraliters/milliliters/ounces/fluid ounces and pounds. The tare button allows you to weigh food in a bowl or other container and get just the weight of the food. The scale is very accurate. Overall, I think it's a great scale for the money: small, easy to store, versatile and accurate.This scale has a small footprint and is low profile.
